observations.observation: Converging guide markers continuously stream outward from the horizon, preserving an unbroken forward-travel read throughout the clip.
Small horizon elements, intermediate queued objects, and large edge-passing foreground markers provide consistently distinguishable far, mid, and near layers.
The yellow ring grows smoothly from depth and exits below the viewer while nearer guide markers pass regularly without visible jumps.
The red solid polygon advances with continuous scaling, reaches the foreground, and exits rather than stopping or resetting.
The green three-lobed organic target approaches, remains recognizable during enlargement, and passes out of view.
After the organic target exits, the guide-marker flow continues clearly, confirming travel through the final target-free interval.
All 375 native 25 fps frames are distinct, and no observable interval remains still for five consecutive frames.
